description: This Java class 'ObsReferenceRange' models a reference range associated with a specific observational data point (Obs) in the OpenMRS medical record system. It extends 'BaseReferenceRange' and includes ORM mappings using JPA annotations, representing entities for persistence in a relational database.

classes.name: ObsReferenceRange
classes.description: Entity class representing a reference range for an Observation in OpenMRS, including ORM annotations for persistence, and methods for accessing and modifying its properties.
